en.title: GugoPro AI Ziwei Astrology Master
en.description: GugoPro AI Ziwei Astrology Master: compare two or more birth-data profiles with multi-room sessions, dynamic Gemini routing and reflective relationship guidance.
en.profileHint: Profiles stay in this browser; load them into a comparison in one click.
en.annualHint: Starting from the current year, this converts both profiles into 0–100 reflective trend proxies for comparing rhythm and gaps; it is not deterministic prediction.
en.annualActionText: Use larger gaps as prompts for dialogue, planning and boundary experiments—not as the sole basis for high-stakes decisions.
en.annualDataHint: The chart updates when birth details or the selected lens changes.
en.annualSihuaTitle: Annual Four Transformations & Hua Ji reminders
en.annualSihuaHint: Using a common Heavenly-Stem Four Transformations table, this summarizes Lu, Quan, Ke and Hua Ji plus palace-axis checks; it is cultural reflection, not deterministic prediction.
en.annualSihuaMethodText: This page uses one common ten-stem reference table; some schools vary, especially for Wu, Geng and Ren. Because a complete star-to-palace chart is not entered here, the tool does not invent exact Hua Ji palace placements; it uses the relationship lens and opposite-palace axis as a verification cue.
en.annualSihuaActionText: Verify facts, roles and boundaries first, then turn the cue into a concrete conversation or planning experiment.
en.relationRequired: Add the related person's birth date before starting a comparison.
en.kicker: Cultural reflection × AI dialogue × relationship comparison
en.heroTitle: Turn chart questions into practical reflection
en.heroLead: Add birth details and a consultation focus. The AI uses the cultural language of Sanhe and Four Transformations to organize the twelve palaces and action prompts. This is reflective guidance, not deterministic prediction.
en.inputHint: Data stays in this browser; verify lunar dates and Four Pillars yourself.
en.baziPh: e.g. Jia-Zi year / Bing-Yin month / Wu-Wu day / Geng-Shen hour
en.chartHint: This sends birth details, time branch, gender, the twelve-palace list and your focus to the AI.
en.empty: Prepare the chart context above, then choose a quick topic or type a question.
en.placeholder: Ask about your chart, for example: How can I reflect on my work rhythm this year?
en.pdfTitle: GugoPro AI Ziwei Astrology Reflection Report
en.pdfSubtitle: Chart context and AI conversation summary for cultural reflection and sharing
en.pdfSihua: Annual Four Transformations & Hua Ji reminders
en.pdfDisclaimer: Important note: This report is for cultural and reflective use. It is not a scientific forecast and does not replace medical, legal, financial or mental-health professionals. Verify birth dates, lunar dates and Four Pillars yourself.

de.heroTitle: Fragen zum Horoskop in umsetzbare Einsichten verwandeln
de.heroLead: Geben Sie Geburtsdaten und ein Thema ein. Die KI ordnet Zwölf Paläste, Vier Transformationen und Handlungsideen kulturell ein. Dies ist Reflexion, keine deterministische Vorhersage.
